name: freeticket
description: Operate FreeTicket from any agent: skills for the ft CLI, event copy, and the MCP server that exposes the B2B, superadmin and public contracts as tools.

interface.shortDescription: Manage events, ticket sales and reports with FreeTicket.
interface.longDescription: Discover public events and check ticket availability. Authorized organizers can manage events, dates, ticket types, sales, memberships and reports in their connected workspace. Superadmin operations require separate superadmin authorization. Write actions can create, update, cancel, refund or delete data and destructive actions require confirmation. Buyers complete payment through the returned hosted checkout link; the agent never handles card data. Includes guidance for the FreeTicket CLI, event copy and remote MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Find public events and available tickets.
Create a draft event with one date and ticket types.
Show sales and inventory for my selected event.
